questions.questionText: A person saves 10% of his income. His income rises by 25% while his expenditure stays the same. By what percent do his savings increase?
questions.explanation: Let income = 100, so savings = 10, expenditure = 90. New income = 125, new savings = 35. Increase = 25/10 x 100 = 250%.

questions.questionText: The price of an item goes up by 10% and a family cuts its consumption by 10%. What is the change in the family's expenditure on it?

questions.questionText: In a class of 720 students, 1008 are girls. What percent of the class are girls?

questions.questionText: A trader increases the price of an item by 50%, then by another 10%, and finally gives a discount of 40%. What is the net change in price?
